basic_profile.bio: Hi, I'm Alex, a college student from Virginia, majoring in Mechanical Engineering. I'm a big fan of tech gadgets and love keeping up with the latest in electric skateboards. I recently got into gaming, particularly anything related to Star Wars and quirky games like Katamari. I'm usually online in the evenings after classes and work part-time at a local cafe. I'm single and enjoy spending my free time exploring new online communities and learning about different cultures.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong interest in technology and mechanics, thanks to my engineering studies. I often learn about new gadgets through forums and online communities. My gaming knowledge is mostly self-taught, as I recently started exploring video games for fun and relaxation.
